venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL beat target +8.2% ($8,533 vs ~$7,890) on Saturday.** Food $616. Comps $183. 271 guests / $31.49 GCA. **Target note:** the typeform showed a Daily Sales Target of $789, which is a dropped-digit typo — recent Saturday targets ran $7,745-$8,092 (5/23 $8,092, 5/16 $7,857), so the value was corrected to ~$7,890 for vs-target math; flag for confirmation. **'Another busy start to the shift at Close Company Atlanta!'** MOD supported the bartender through the push; closer in at 8pm, DJ at 9pm. Consistent flow 8-11pm with guests enjoying multiple rounds and getting to know their neighbors — 'another great night as far as DJs go.' Draft Guinness up and running; nearly out of bottle rose and starting on draft rose. **Kitchen**: taste-test products for quality; special eye on popcorn salting. **86**: yellow, cast iron, ocho repo, wings, jojos, ocho plata. No incident, no no-shows charged. **Highlight**: 'Seeing our guests come in as strangers and leave as friends.' MOD: Jk. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH beat target +8.7% ($17,063 vs $15,701) on Saturday — 1-YEAR ANNIVERSARY PARTY.** Food $423. Comps $222.10 (1.3%). 629 guests / $27.13 GCA — the venue's biggest headcount of the period. **'We had an incredible 1st birthday! Tonight was a lot of fun, both for us and for our guests.'** The band read the room beautifully; DJ Derek (with the venue since the beginning) came back from tour to spin — 'he understands our vibe and culture very well.' Busy right out of the gate and pushed through until ~1am; 'the team crushed it all around.' Grateful to have McKenzie in house. **Kitchen**: 'Crushing it — thank you Kevin and John-Michael.' **Maintenance**: kitchen door, walk-in door. No incident, no no-shows charged. **Event**: 'We had a great bday!' MOD/Chef: KK, MD, KE & KM, JMS. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR beat target +92.1% ($35,538.41 incl. events vs $18,496.10) on Saturday — but the beat is entirely event-driven.** Restaurant net $16,579.01 (DC/AM $1,658.15 + D&C PM $14,920.86) came in -10.4% against the $18,496.10 target; a large private event added Net Event Sales of $18,959.40 (event food $8,138), bringing the incl-events total to $35,538.41. Total food incl. events $11,629.95. Comps $588.03 (3.55%). 379 restaurant guests (Tock); GCA $43.74 on restaurant net (the event's 30+ guests are not in the Tock count). **DC/AM (Felix)**: 'Killer, steady day with Care Leite; good afternoon cocktail pop from folks headed to the show.' **D&C PM (Carey)**: 'Busy night with a very well-contained wedding. Short behind the bar and on the floor — felt the pinch — but saved face through guest conversation and menu-launch goodwill without unnecessary comps.' **Event (Kelly)**: 'Air Inc happy hour, 30+ guests, 3-6pm in Vauxhall — passed apps + a reception snack station; Justice & Nathan cranked libations; host thanked us on the way to the Rockies game.' **Kitchen (Nate)**: 'Steady service.' **Maintenance**: ice machines went down mid-shift (one completely down); didn't end service but got to the bottom — Easy Ice assessing in the morning; TRH knows. No incident, no no-shows charged. MOD: Evan/Maggie H/Josh (AM) / Carey & Lucas (PM). Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV beat target +32.5% ($8,613 vs $6,500) on Saturday.** Food $979 + Bev $7,634; net (excl/incl events) $8,613. 249 guests (Sevenrooms) / $34.59 GCA. Comps $189.66 (half investors and members). **'A volume night defined by lots of mid- and large-tops who thankfully ordered ~two rounds each, and a lot of exuberant couples.'** Strong final hour made the night, 'basically making drinks till 2am.' **Headwind flagged by MOD**: an excess of investor/member reservations created a horrific 8pm flow; recommends trimming weekend 8/10pm books. Two 10pm two-tops no-showed (plus one very late), compounding held-table strain — suggests priority-waitlist treatment for such resos. **Door**: 'Solid start, full by 7pm and stayed full most of the night; slight 10pm lull on a large turn + 2 no-shows, recovered quickly, full to last call. Streets very quiet.' No-shows: Josh Foo (4 @ 6pm), Braden Stadlman (2 @ 10pm), Caity Hinton (2 @ 10pm). **Kitchen**: 'Busy, amazing.' **Glassware**: 3 wine, 3 DOF, 2 tulip. No no-shows charged. Top sellers: Masari, Material Control, First Time Listener. MOD/Chef: Seth & Steves/Alejandro. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA beat target +35.2% ($11,487 vs $8,498) on Saturday.** Marquee $9,431 + Standing Room $2,056. Food $1,779. Comps $411 (industry, investors, birthdays, anniversaries, DNL, service recovery). 299 guests / $38.42 GCA (calculated; form-entered GCA of $94.94 is a per-check figure / entry error, consistent with LA's recurring pattern). **'A pretty steady Saturday night.'** Opened with 130 covers and a mellow first hour — used the time to train two new security guards who turned up right before service (big shout-out to Ben for walking them through the night at the security stand). Gradually busier until 9pm, when both rooms filled with a deep waitlist; team burned and turned all night to seat everyone timely. Lots of guests trying the new menu with great feedback. **Kitchen**: 'Busy night!' No incident. No-shows charged. **Highlight**: 'Seeing the team step up.' MOD/Chef: Joe + Josh + Selenia. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Warm and humid with scattered rain showers
venues.narrative: **MG beat target +28.4% ($21,823 vs $17,000) on Saturday — strong close to graduation/wedding weekend.** Segments: MB Morning $4,101 (62 covers), MB Evening $18,333 (238 covers), Sun Club $1,635, Hot Eye $3,340. Food $7,480. Comps $683. 300 MB OpenTable guests / $72.74 GCA. **Morning (Sam)**: 'Solid, steady Saturday — business from 8-9am, brief lull, busiest push ~11am, then a comfortable pace; a couple food tours in the afternoon. No major rushes or issues.' **Evening (Gabby/Shannon)**: 'Extremely busy start with a strong 4-6pm happy hour — packed with walk-ins, resos, and a large portion of the hotel wedding block at the bar. Hectic HH-to-dinner transition handled well; very quick early turns, then a solid 7-8pm reservation push. Business tapered earlier than expected, volume concentrated in the early evening. A great Saturday.' **Sun Club**: 'Very busy early with the wedding block; steady MB overflow through the day. Rain at 8pm led to a quicker close.' **Hot Eye**: 'Steady-but-slower start, big 9pm pop coasting through the night; some difficulty with large parties blocking the bar entrance/exit. Industry pop at 11, room died down till 12:30 when the whole wedding party arrived post-reception — sent them off with all remaining beer. SO to Sam for loading more beer from finance.' **Kitchen**: 'Slammed 4pm through close; a few longer ticket times on volume but the BOH crushed it — absolute rockstars.' No incident. **Highlight**: 'Watching FOH and BOH stay positive and crush an absolute banger of a weekend.' Morning MOD: Sam / Evening MOD: Gabby & Shannon. Entered by Alexis.
